examples.text: At the end of the first twelve-month period, this arrangement continues for successive twelve-month periods unless written notice reaches the provider at least forty-five days before the current period ends.
If you do not use the exit window shown in your account, access carries on into the next cycle and the recurring payment is collected at the rate then in effect.
Your membership remains active until you tell us to stop it; a request received after the monthly processing date takes effect in the following cycle.
A handling amount may be added to each payment to reflect the provider's processing costs, with the amount set by the provider from time to time.
When payment is initiated through a partner channel, a convenience amount shown only on the final confirmation screen is added per transaction.
You are responsible for the reasonable costs we incur in recovering an overdue balance, including the fees of any collection service we appoint.
Once the service period starts, the advance remains with us even if you stop using the service before that period ends.
If you leave before the initial commitment expires, the remaining scheduled instalments continue to be due.
Unused credits in your account expire when the membership is closed and cannot be transferred or exchanged for money.
We may revise the service conditions by posting a new version in the portal. Your continued use after the posting date will count as acceptance.
The provider can alter the available features or the price at its discretion; the revised terms take effect when displayed in the account.
A change uploaded to this page becomes part of your agreement after seven days, and using the service after that date signifies agreement.
Any disagreement connected with this service must be decided by a single arbitrator appointed by the provider, with proceedings held in the provider's chosen city.
You waive the right to bring or participate in a representative or group claim and agree to resolve each claim individually through our online process.
Before filing a claim, you must send a written dispute notice and allow us ninety days to respond; court proceedings may be brought only in the listed venue.
To the maximum extent permitted, we are not responsible for indirect or consequential loss, including lost profits, data, or business opportunities.
Your total recovery from us for all events in a calendar year cannot exceed the fees you paid during the preceding thirty days.
You must defend and reimburse the provider for third-party claims arising from use of the service, including claims caused in part by the provider's own conduct.
We may suspend or close your account at any time, with or without a stated reason, while all amounts for the remainder of your commitment stay payable.
You must report any discrepancy within twenty-four hours of receiving the service; otherwise, the delivery will be treated as accepted in full.
The provider may decide in its sole judgment whether a request qualifies for support, and no review or appeal of that decision is available.
You allow us to use precise location information from your device and share it with selected advertising partners to personalise offers.
Any material you upload grants the provider a perpetual, worldwide, transferable right to reproduce, adapt, and commercially use that material.
You are responsible for all duties, import charges, and penalties imposed by authorities on products delivered under this arrangement.
You may cancel your appointment at any time without a charge, and any amount already paid will be returned to the original payment method.
The word renewal in this document refers only to renewal of a certificate. This service does not renew automatically and no further payment is taken.
All charges are shown before checkout, the displayed total includes applicable taxes, and no additional payment is due for standard delivery.
The provider will not change the agreed monthly amount or service scope during the current term without your express written agreement.
Either party may raise a dispute in court. The parties may choose mediation by mutual agreement, and neither party gives up any available remedy.
The company accepts responsibility for direct losses caused by its failure to provide the service, subject to the remedies described in this agreement.
The provider will reimburse the customer for reasonable losses caused by the provider's breach of this agreement.
We do not sell your personal information or use precise location data for advertising. Location access is optional and can be turned off at any time.
A receipt is available for download after each payment. You may print it or save a copy for your records.
The provider may change the display colour of the account dashboard. This visual change does not change the service, price, or these terms.
No collection fee applies, and we will not charge a penalty for a payment that arrives after the due date.
The provider may close the free preview at any time. The preview has no paid commitment, no automatic renewal, and no amount becomes due after closure.
The membership does not renew automatically. No recurring payment will be collected unless you actively select a new plan.
The booking payment is non-refundable if you cancel. This restriction does not apply when the provider cancels the booking or fails to make the service available.
